text: Felix Nakamura opens Python and writes the real classical baseline solver -- the first actual code in this part of the project.
NumPy vectors and a covariance matrix stand in for Meridian's 12 candidate assets' expected returns and risk.
itertools.combinations checks all 495 possible 4-asset portfolios directly -- no shortcuts, no approximation, every single one.
The output: the exact optimal portfolio and its objective score -- real, trustworthy ground truth now exists for comparison.
Next: implementing the portfolio QUBO as a real QAOA circuit in Qiskit.
